description_for_human: Pay-per-read articles and pay-per-second video on Arc Mainnet. All payments in USDC.
description_for_model: Access Readlearc content. Use GET /api/agent to discover the catalogue (articles and videos). Each call requires a USDC micropayment on Arc Mainnet (chain 5042). Articles are priced per-read; videos are priced per second via a payment channel. Send X-Payment-Response header with a valid on-chain transaction hash to receive content.

endpoints.description: Catalogue of articles and videos. Requires x402 USDC payment.
Fetch a specific article (type=article) or video metadata (type=video) by contentId.
